brand.name: RythuConnect
brand.mission: A multilingual farmer-to-buyer marketplace helping Indian farmers sell crops directly, minimize middleman dependency, and achieve fair, transparent pricing.

auth.login_subtitle: Enter your mobile phone number to receive a secure login OTP.
auth.register_subtitle: Select your marketplace role and verify your mobile phone number.
auth.farmer_role_desc: I want to sell my farm harvest directly to buyers.
auth.buyer_role_desc: I want to buy fresh agricultural crops directly from farmers.
auth.otp_subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code sent to your phone

auth.invalid_otp: Please enter a valid 6-digit verification code.
auth.role_required: Please select whether you are a Farmer or a Buyer.
auth.logout_confirm: Are you sure you want to log out?

unauthorized.title: Access Restricted

landing.hero_desc: A multilingual agriculture marketplace helping farmers sell produce directly to buyers, eliminate middleman dependency, and discover fair, transparent market opportunities.
landing.roles_subheading: Tailored interfaces designed specifically for harvest producers and commercial buyers.
landing.farmer_desc: List your crops directly, set transparent unit prices, and connect directly with local and commercial buyers without paying intermediary commissions.
landing.buyer_desc: Source fresh, verified agricultural produce directly from farm origins with verifiable harvest details and clear per-unit prices.

listings.dashboard_subtitle: Manage your crops, track active listings, and sell directly to buyers.
listings.my_listings_subtitle: All produce and harvests you have posted for sale.
listings.create_subtitle: Provide crop harvest and pricing details to publish to the direct marketplace.
listings.edit_subtitle: Update harvest quantities, pricing, or delivery specifications.
listings.crop_name_placeholder: e.g., Organic Sona Masoori Rice, Fresh Tomatoes
listings.delivery_charge_hint: Enter delivery charge if you provide transport (optional)
listings.location_placeholder: e.g., Tenali, Guntur District, Andhra Pradesh
listings.image_hint: Provide publicly accessible HTTP/HTTPS image URLs (maximum 5)
listings.mark_sold_confirm_desc: Once marked as SOLD, buyers will see this listing as completed. This action cannot be reversed.
listings.delete_confirm_desc: Are you sure you want to delete this listing? This will permanently remove it from your active marketplace listings.
listings.sold_cannot_edit: This listing has been marked as SOLD and can no longer be edited.
listings.created_success: Your crop listing has been published successfully!
listings.no_listings_desc: You haven't added any crop listings. Post your first harvest to connect with interested buyers directly.
listings.empty_filter_desc: There are no listings matching the selected status filter.
